Reminds your child to learn %1$d characters
Only at your set time. No marketing.
Android will ask once more for notification permission.
Look at the character for now, and try again later
Tap a character to hear it
This area is for grown-ups. A wrong PIN simply clears — try again.
Set daily learning goals and reminders.
A new goal applies from the next plan. If today’s practice has already started, today keeps its goal.
Choose reminder days. Deselect all days to turn reminders off.
Choose a time and weekdays in Learning plan. LittleStar sends one reminder on those days and stays quiet once the daily goal is complete.
Notifications are off. Allow them in system settings to see the reminder.
Android asks for notification permission the first time. You can change this later in system settings.
All characters, audio and illustrations are built in. LittleStar does not request Internet access and does not send learning data anywhere.

Version %1$s
Offline Chinese literacy for heritage kids.
No ads, no account, no network access.

%2$s

Media credits
Word recordings are normalized and converted to Ogg Vorbis; no speech synthesis, pitch changes or speed changes. Adapted recordings retain their source licenses.
Photos are resized RGB PNGs. Theme icons, colour cues and the snake cover are OpenMoji illustrations, not photographs. OpenMoji PNGs are unmodified and retain CC BY-SA 4.0. Sources, licenses, hashes and processing details are bundled in assets/content/media_sources.json.
